in_marathi.name: Mitansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mitansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mitansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'mi' meaning 'measure' and 'tansh' meaning 'count'. This name is often given to a child born on a day when precise measurements and counting are significant, such as during a harvest or a religious ceremony.
